HACL* as compiled into CPython 3.14.8 (python:3.14.8-slim-trixie): _blake2, _hmac,
_md5, _sha1, _sha2 and _sha3 modules. Source: https://github.com/python/cpython/tree/v3.14.8/Modules/_hacl
The texts below are copied verbatim from the headers of those source files.
